content:
# Cultist trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyCultist | Source: Cultist | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Cultist trophy is a rare drop, 10% chance, from Cultists in the Mountains.

### Crafting

• Fenris hood

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item stand.
• Can be used to program Ballistas.

## Notes

• Cultist trophies can be hard to obtain from only Frost Caves, a solution is to do the Hildir´s quest and kill Geirrhafa to activate the raid Event "You get the chills..." since Cultists will spawn during this raid.

Categorias: Trophies
